entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Normalize default JSON column name handling #39730
    12.0.0
  • Include fails when the principal key is defined on a complex type property (follow-up to #38759) #39722
  • SQL Server: OPENJSON WITH ... AS JSON columns carry a json type mapping even when the server returns nvarchar(max) #39719
    Backlog
  • EF Core 11: first value of an optional owned reference is not saved if change detection runs before a tracking query returns its owner #39717
    11.0.2
  • Regression in EF Core 11: ExecuteUpdate throws "does not represent a valid value" for setter from LEFT JOIN to GroupBy subquery (SQL Server; works in EF Core 10) #39714
    Backlog
  • SQLite: Math.Sign(int) is not translated #39712
    12.0-preview1

Closed

  • EF Core 11: replaced owned reference is not saved if a tracking query returns its owner before SaveChanges #39595
    11.0.1
  • Regression in 11.0: replacing an owned instance or re-adding an entity with the same key sets unchanged OnAdd properties to null #39617
    11.0.1
  • EF Core 11: Setting an optional complex property to null is not persisted for TPH sibling types that map the same columns #39596
    11.0.1
  • Unhelpful translation error when a collection property is configured with Property() in 11 #39600
    11.0.1
  • GroupJoin in EF Core 9/10 returns single row for SQL Server temporal tables #37288
    12.0-preview1
  • Migrations: Down() drops a database-level object (Npgsql collation) before reverting the columns that use it #39563
    12.0-preview1
  • Ternary false-expression does not take ternary condition into account, resulting in slow execution on SQL Server #36293
    12.0-preview1
  • Wrong translation for default(DateTime)/default(Guid)/default(TimeSpan) in linq projection #24075
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Translate LINQ Append and Prepend #39729
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Preserve first values of optional owned references across tracking queries #39728
  • Use the update sproc when a delete and insert are merged into an update #39727
    community-contribution
  • Fix #34849: Union in collection subquery cannot be translated #39726
    community-contribution
  • [release/10.0]: Bump StyleCop.Analyzers from 1.1.118 to 1.3.180 #39725
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.20.1 to 1.21.0 #39724
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix ExecuteUpdate setter over left-joined GroupBy projection #39721
    community-contribution
  • SQLite: translate Math.Sign(int) #39720
    community-contribution
  • Make MinBy over subquery test deterministic #39718
  • Fix JSON_CONTAINS for nested JSON documents #39715
    area-harness
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39713

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39707
  • Bump Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp and Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces #39681
    area-infrastructure
  • Propagate column nullability from failed CASE tests to later clauses #39660
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Cast all projected date/time and Guid constants #39659
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1
  • Identify rows of temporal range queries by their period #39661
    community-contribution
  • Drop removed database-level annotations after table and column operations #39666
    community-contribution, 12.0-preview1

Updated

  • Apply navigation expansion to the rest of a lifted GroupBy projection #39693
    community-contribution
  • Support complex properties on owned types #39522
    community-contribution
  • Fix MinBy/MaxBy null-key handling with index-friendly selection #39653
    community-contribution
  • SQL Server: read long strings in full when projecting JSON collection elements #39709
    community-contribution
  • Fix SQL Server JSON_CONTAINS type handling #39706
    area-harness
  • Use SQLite indexes for simple Boolean counts and list queries #39711
    community-contribution
  • Translate TimeOnly.IsBetween on SQLite #39682
    community-contribution
  • Throw when same-named DbParameters are hard-coded in FromSql/SqlQuery SQL #39593
    breaking-change, community-contribution
